clue.text: Standard minimum return for Jack, so it appears

explanation.surface: A minimum standard set for some sailor called Jack, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return for' turns AB round to BA.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic pay or provision is the fundamental, standard minimum level.

clue.text: Seaman observed snake way up on cart

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another comes before it

parts.note: a boa is a large constricting snake

a wain is an old word for a farm cart

explanation.surface: A sailor watched a snake travel up the road on top of a cart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ST into TS; 'observed' is only a link. A boatswain (bosun) is the ship's officer in charge of rigging.
explanation.definitionFit: A boatswain is a ship's officer, a sailor in charge of deck crew and equipment.

clue.text: Girl is cutting the plant

parts.note: Sal is a short girl's name, from Sally or Sarah
taken as written

clue.text: Colouring of carbonaceous rock seen around a ravine

explanation.surface: A geological description of coal visible around a gorge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen' and 'a' are links. CHINE is a coastal ravine, as on the Isle of Wight.
explanation.definitionFit: Cochineal is a red dye made from crushed insects, used to colour food.

clue.text: State with modern milk distributor

parts.note: new means modern

explanation.surface: A government body with a modern milk delivery service.

explanation.definitionFit: New Jersey is one of the fifty constituent states of the USA.

clue.text: Sister accepting a Church's nice distinctions

taken as written
CE, Church of England, plus the possessive S

explanation.surface: A nun welcomes a church's fine theological points.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuances are subtle shades of meaning, fine differences; nice here means precise.

clue.text: Emotionally upset by tiny ringing sound

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small

clue.text: American student hopes room has been changed

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Interest that's left in yearling deposits initially

clue.text: Colleague with a diploma?

definitions.meaning: one holding an ... qualification, a diploma below full membership

explanation.definitionFit: An associate is a partner or fellow worker, and also a holder of a qualifying diploma from a professional body, such as an Associate of a Royal College.

clue.text: Tree with top removed, bearing soft fruit

explanation.definitionFit: An apple is the fruit of a familiar orchard tree.

clue.text: Stew lacking a sausage? On the contrary

parts.note: salami is a spiced Italian sausage
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'On the contrary' flips the surface: it is not the stew that lacks a sausage, but the sausage that lacks A, making the stew. A salmi is a game ragout.
explanation.definitionFit: A salmi is a ragout or rich stew of game birds.

clue.text: Issue a poet experienced when young

explanation.surface: An issue a poet lived through in his youth.

clue.text: Skilfulness in making a speech

a formal talk delivered to an audience

clue.text: Cheat about to overcharge to a high degree

clue.text: Wholly sensible pronouncements from Judges?

clue.text: Tangible diplomacy on French island

clue.text: Hypocrisy, even for a poet, to eat here

clue.text: Cape — one found in paid supervisor's trunk

clue.text: Ill-feeling engendered by a pet, say?

clue.text: Outstanding start for Olympic footballer

clue.text: A theological journalist summed up thus
